name: true-grit-level-up
description: RISK-04 / S4 T6. It runs disposable-true-grit-level-up-transaction: a disposable Gunslinger advanced to 19 by the native level-up controller is taken through real level-20 visits holding the two True Grit states. A cancelled visit and a visit that throws after holding two deeds must leave it unchanged; the same deed is attempted in both states, before and after back navigation, with replacement, before a LevelUpState.IsComplete-gated commit that must leave exactly two different deeds at rank one; then a cancelled and a committed native respec. No save is loaded.
